page.layout: One printed page, a digitiser's cover sheet: title block at top centre, then a rule, a multilingual e-rara.ch note and a second rule with terms of use below. No margins with text.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a page of the printed book. Omitted as page furniture: the e-rara logo, the Visual Library logo, the digitiser's title block (www.e-rara.ch, "Antiquitatum convivialium libri III", Stucki, Johann Wilhelm, Tiguri, anno 1582, Zentralbibliothek Zürich, shelf mark III F 35 | F, persistent link), the multilingual platform note and the terms-of-use notice. The page has no printed text of the original book.
